blurb.bm: Kota bersejarah di tepi laut George Town, bersebelahan Padang Kota Lama.
blurb.en: A historic fort on the George Town waterfront, beside the old Padang.

ask.bm: Francis Light mendarat di sini pada tahun…

why.bm: Ya, 1786! Kota pertama hanya diperbuat daripada batang nibung.
why.en: Yes, 1786! The first fort was just a stockade of nibong palm trunks.

intro.bm: Kota Cornwallis ialah kota bersejarah di hujung timur laut George Town.
intro.en: Fort Cornwallis is a historic fort at the north-east tip of George Town.

bm: Pada 1786, Kapten Francis Light membina kubu pertama daripada batang pokok nibung.
Dari 1804 hingga 1810, banduan India membinanya semula dengan bata dan batu.
Ia dinamakan sempena Earl Cornwallis, Gabenor Jeneral Bengal ketika itu.
en: In 1786, Captain Francis Light built the first stockade from nibong palm trunks.
From 1804 to 1810, Indian convict labourers rebuilt it in brick and stone.
It is named after Earl Cornwallis, Governor-General of Bengal at the time.

fun.bm: Meriam Seri Rambai dibuat pada 1603 dan berpindah tangan dari Belanda ke Johor, Aceh dan Selangor sebelum sampai ke Pulau Pinang.
fun.en: The Seri Rambai cannon was cast in 1603 and passed from the Dutch to Johor, Aceh and Selangor before reaching Penang.
